# 0 Set up environment
```{r}
# Clean environment
rm( list = ls() )

# load libraries
library(qqman)
library(circlize)
library(VennDiagram)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggplot2)


# Prepare Plotting functions 
manhattan_plot <- function(data, data_full, type, ann=T) {
  # Compute significance threshold
  threshold <- -log10(0.05 / nrow(data_full))
  if (type=="DBGWAS"){
    threshold <- -log10(0.05 / 87899)
  }
  
  # Subset for significant hits (above threshold and not NA in label)
  ann_sub <- data[ -log10(data$lrt.pvalue) > threshold & !is.na(data[["gene"]]), ]
  
  # Calculate expanded y limits
   y_max <- max(-log10(data$lrt.pvalue), na.rm = TRUE)
   y_lim <- c(0, max(y_max,threshold) * 1.10)
  
  plot <- ggplot(data, aes(x=POS, y=-log10(lrt.pvalue))) +
    geom_point(aes(color=OR_pos), alpha=0.8, size=1.3) +
    scale_color_manual(values= c("skyblue", "orange")) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = y_lim) +
    theme_bw()+
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),  
    legend.position = c(0.02, 0.6),     # inside plot
    legend.direction = "horizontal",     # horizontal legend
    legend.justification = c(0, 1),      # anchor top-left
    legend.box.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
    labs(
      x = "Genomic Position (Start)",
      y = expression(-log[10](italic(p))),
      title = paste0(type, " Manhattan Plot")
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = threshold, color="red", lty="dashed") 
  
  if(ann==F){
   plot
  }else{
    plot +
    geom_label_repel(
      data = ann_sub,
      aes(label = .data[["gene"]]),
      size = 3,
      min.segment.length = 1,
      show.legend = FALSE,
      na.rm = TRUE, 
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      force = 10, 
      force_pull = 10,
  box.padding = 1,    # more space around each label
  point.padding = 0.3)
  }
}

QQ_plot <- function(data, type){
  df <- data.frame(expected= (-log10(ppoints(length(data |> pull(lrt.pvalue))))), 
                             observed=(-log10(sort(data |> pull(lrt.pvalue))))) 
  df |>
    ggplot(aes(x = expected, y = observed)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, color="red", lty="dashed")  +      
  labs(
    x = "-log10(Expected P-value)",
    y = "-log10(Observed P-value)",
    title = paste0(type," QQ-plot")
  ) +
  theme_minimal()+
  xlim(0, 10) +
  ylim(0, 10)+
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)) 
}

# Load table
Missingness_Prop <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Pyseer Results/CDC/Missingness_Prop.txt", header=F, sep=" ")
colnames(Missingness_Prop) <- c("POS", "Missingness_Proportion")
accessory_regions <- Missingness_Prop |> filter(Missingness_Proportion>=0.05) |> pull(POS)
```

# 1. Main Analysis
# 1.1. SNP-GWAS (Fastree DP LMM, Panaroo, Binary)
```{r}
# Load GWAS results
SNPGWAS_data <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Pyseer Results/CDC/Population_Structure_Methods/FastTree_DP_LMM/SNPGWAS.txt", sep = "\t", header=T)|> 
  filter(af>=0.05, af <0.95)|> 
  mutate(POS=as.integer(str_split(as.character(variant), "_", simplify = T)[,2]), 
         OR = exp(beta), 
         OR_pos =ifelse(OR<1, "OR<1", "OR>1"))

# Load Annotations
SNPGWAS_ann <- read.csv("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Pyseer Results/CDC/Population_Structure_Methods/FastTree_DP_LMM/SNP_annotations.csv", header=F)
colnames(SNPGWAS_ann) <- c("POS", "REF", "ALT", "FUNCLASS", "IMPACT", "gene", "nt_change", "aa_change")
SNPGWAS_ann_df <- left_join(SNPGWAS_data,
  SNPGWAS_ann |>
  mutate(variant = paste("AP018935.1", POS, REF, ALT, sep="_")))

# Manhattan Plot
SNPGWAS_manplot <- manhattan_plot(SNPGWAS_ann_df, SNPGWAS_ann_df, "SNP-GWAS")
SNPGWAS_manplot

# Sig hits 
SNPGWAS_sig <- SNPGWAS_ann_df |> 
  filter(lrt.pvalue < 0.05 /nrow(SNPGWAS_ann_df)) |>
  mutate(OR = exp(beta),
    OR_lower = exp(beta - 1.96 * beta.std.err),
    OR_upper = exp(beta + 1.96 * beta.std.err),
    OR_CI = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f; %.2f)", OR, OR_lower, OR_upper),
    P_value = formatC(lrt.pvalue, format = "e", digits = 2), 
    variant2= paste0(REF, POS,ALT),
    type = ifelse(IMPACT == "MODIFIER", "Non-coding", 
                  ifelse(IMPACT == "LOW", "Synonymous", "Non-Synonymous")),
    aa_change2= str_remove(aa_change, "p."),
    annotation = paste0("Mutation: ", type, " (", aa_change2,"); gene: ", gene)) |> 
  select(variant2 , af, OR_CI, P_value, annotation)|>
  rename(variant=variant2)
SNPGWAS_sig

# QQ plot 
SNPGWAS_qqplot <- QQ_plot(SNPGWAS_data, "SNP-GWAS") 
SNPGWAS_qqplot
```

# 1.2. DB-GWAS (Fastree DP LMM, Panaroo, Binary)
```{r}
# Load GWAS results
DBGWAS_data <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Pyseer Results/CDC/Population_Structure_Methods/FastTree_DP_LMM/DBGWAS.txt", sep = "\t", header=T) |> 
  filter(af >=0.05, af <0.95)

# Load Annotations
DBGWAS_ann <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Pyseer Results/CDC/Population_Structure_Methods/FastTree_DP_LMM/DBGWAS_annotation.txt", sep = "\t", header=F) 
colnames(DBGWAS_ann) <- colnames(DBGWAS_data)
DBGWAS_ann <- DBGWAS_ann |> 
  filter(af >=0.05, af <0.95)|>
  mutate(ref_unaligned = ifelse(str_extract(notes, "^[^:]+")=="AP018935.1", "ref genome", "unaligned contig"), 
         coord_range = str_extract(notes, "(?<=:)[0-9]+-[0-9]+"), 
         start= str_split(coord_range, "-", simplify = T)[,1], 
         end= str_split(coord_range, "-", simplify = T)[,2],
         POS = as.integer(str_extract(coord_range, "^[0-9]+")),
         OR = exp(beta), 
         OR_pos =ifelse(OR<1, "OR<1", "OR>1"),
         ref_unaligned2 = ifelse(ref_unaligned=="ref genome", ifelse(POS %in% accessory_regions, paste0(ref_unaligned, "; accessory region"), paste0(ref_unaligned, "; core region")), ref_unaligned))  |>
  separate(
    notes, 
    into = c("contig_position", "upstream", "gene", "downstream"), 
    sep = ";", 
    remove = FALSE, 
    fill = "right"
  )

# Manhattan Plot
DBGWAS_manplot <- manhattan_plot(DBGWAS_ann |> filter(ref_unaligned=="ref genome") , DBGWAS_ann, "DBGWAS")
DBGWAS_manplot

# Sig hits
DBGWAS_sig <- DBGWAS_ann |> 
  filter(lrt.pvalue < 0.05 / 87899) |>
  mutate(ref_unaligned = factor(ref_unaligned, levels= c("ref genome", "unaligned contig")))|>
  arrange(ref_unaligned, as.numeric(start))|>
  mutate(
    OR = exp(beta),
    OR_lower = exp(beta - 1.96 * beta.std.err),
    OR_upper = exp(beta + 1.96 * beta.std.err),
    OR_CI = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f; %.2f)", OR, OR_lower, OR_upper),
    P_value = formatC(lrt.pvalue, format = "e", digits = 2)
  ) |>
  mutate(variant2= paste0("Unitig ",row_number()), 
         annotation= paste0("coord:", coord_range, " (", ref_unaligned2,  "); gene: ", gene))|> 
  select(variant2, af, OR_CI, P_value, annotation) |>
  rename(variant=variant2)
DBGWAS_sig

# QQ plot 
DBGWAS_qqplot <- QQ_plot(DBGWAS_ann, "DBGWAS")
DBGWAS_qqplot
```
# 1.3. Pan-GWAS (Fastree DP LMM, Panaroo, Binary)
```{r}
# Load GWAS results
PanGWAS_data <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Pyseer Results/CDC/Population_Structure_Methods/FastTree_DP_LMM/PanGWAS.txt", sep = "\t", header=T) |>
  filter(af >=0.05, af <0.95)

# Get significant hits
PanGWAS_sig <- PanGWAS_data |>
  filter(lrt.pvalue < 0.05 / nrow(PanGWAS_data)) |>
  mutate(
    OR = exp(beta),
    OR_lower = exp(beta - 1.96 * beta.std.err),
    OR_upper = exp(beta + 1.96 * beta.std.err),
    OR_CI = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f; %.2f)", OR, OR_lower, OR_upper),
    P_value = formatC(lrt.pvalue, format = "e", digits = 2), 
    annotation= c("Undecaprenyl-phosphate 4-deoxy-4-formamido-L-arabinose transferase, glycosyltransferase family 2", "Glycosyltransferase (glyG)")
  ) |>
  select(variant, af, OR_CI, P_value, annotation)
PanGWAS_sig

# QQ plot 
PanGWAS_qqplot <- QQ_plot(PanGWAS_data, "PanGWAS")
PanGWAS_qqplot
```

# FIGURE - panel of MANHATTAN and QQPlots for SNPGWAS, DBGWAS, PANGWAS 
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggplotify)  # for as.ggplot()

# Turn PanGWAS_sig (data.frame) into a table-plot
PanGWAS_table <- tableGrob(PanGWAS_sig)
PanGWAS_table_plot <- as.ggplot(PanGWAS_table)

# Build rows: (left, right)
row1 <- SNPGWAS_manplot   + DBGWAS_manplot
row2 <- SNPGWAS_qqplot + PanGWAS_qqplot + DBGWAS_qqplot

# Stack rows
final_panel <- row1 / row2 
  plot_layout(heights = c(3, 2))  # adjust column width ratio if needed

final_panel

ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/2. Analysis/MS1 - USA GWAS interpretation/Mahanttan_QQ_plots_panel.png", final_panel, width = 15, height = 10, dpi = 300)
ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/2. Analysis/MS1 - USA GWAS interpretation/Mahanttan_QQ_plots_panel.tiff", final_panel, width = 15, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
  dplyr::select(variant, lt60),
PanGWAS_lt60_sig |> 
  mutate(OR= round(exp(beta), 2),

         CI_hi = round(exp(beta+ 1.96*beta.std.err), 2),
         lt60= paste0(OR, " (",CI_lo, "-",CI_hi,"), p=",lrt.pvalue))|>
  dplyr::select(variant, lt60),
DBGWAS_lt60_sig |> 
  mutate(OR= round(exp(beta), 2),
         CI_lo = round(exp(beta- 1.96*beta.std.err), 2),
         CI_hi = round(exp(beta+ 1.96*beta.std.err), 2),
         lt60= paste0(OR, " (",CI_lo, "-",CI_hi,"), p=",lrt.pvalue))|>
```

```{r}
# SNP-GWAS 
# Load GWAS results
SNPGWAS_NLD <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Pyseer Results/NDL/SNPGWAS.txt", sep = "\t", header=T)|>

# Table of significant hits

         coord_range = str_extract(notes, "(?<=:)[0-9]+-[0-9]+"), 
         start= str_split(coord_range, "-", simplify = T)[,1], 
         end= str_split(coord_range, "-", simplify = T)[,2],
         POS = as.integer(str_extract(coord_range, "^[0-9]+")),
```

# CDC vs NDL PYSEER p-value (using CDC+NDL outputs)
```{r}
# prepare CDC data 
CDC_pyseer_df <- rbind(SNPGWAS_data  |> 
                         select(variant, filter.pvalue, lrt.pvalue, OR)|> 
                         rename(filter.pvalue_CDC=filter.pvalue, lrt.pvalue_CDC= lrt.pvalue, OR_CDC=OR),
                       DBGWAS_CDC_global |>
                         mutate(OR=exp(beta))|> 
                         select(variant, filter.pvalue, lrt.pvalue, OR)|> 
                         rename(filter.pvalue_CDC=filter.pvalue, lrt.pvalue_CDC= lrt.pvalue, OR_CDC=OR),
                       PanGWAS_CDC_global |> 
                         mutate(OR=exp(beta)) |> 
                         select(variant, filter.pvalue, lrt.pvalue, OR)|> 
                         rename(filter.pvalue_CDC=filter.pvalue, lrt.pvalue_CDC= lrt.pvalue, OR_CDC=OR))

# prepare NDL data 
NDL_pyseer_df <- rbind(SNPGWAS_NLD |> 
                         select(variant, filter.pvalue, lrt.pvalue, OR) |> 
                         rename(filter.pvalue_NLD=filter.pvalue, lrt.pvalue_NLD= lrt.pvalue, OR_NLD=OR),
                       DBGWAS_NDL_global |>
                         mutate(OR=exp(beta)) |> 
                         select(variant, filter.pvalue, lrt.pvalue, OR)|> 
                         rename(filter.pvalue_NLD=filter.pvalue, lrt.pvalue_NLD= lrt.pvalue, OR_NLD=OR),
                       PanGWAS_NDL_global|>
                         mutate(OR=exp(beta)) |> 
                         select(variant, filter.pvalue, lrt.pvalue, OR)|> 
                         rename(filter.pvalue_NLD=filter.pvalue, lrt.pvalue_NLD= lrt.pvalue, OR_NLD=OR))


# Combine
NLD_CDC_pyseer_df <- left_join(CDC_pyseer_df, NDL_pyseer_df)


# Plot p-values before population structure adjustment
r_val_filter.pvalue <-cor.test(-log10(NLD_CDC_pyseer_df$filter.pvalue_NLD), -log10(NLD_CDC_pyseer_df$filter.pvalue_CDC))
p_corr_before <- NLD_CDC_pyseer_df |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x = -log10(filter.pvalue_CDC),
                 y = -log10(filter.pvalue_NLD))) +
  theme_classic()+
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 30, y = 20,
    label = paste0("r = ", round(r_val_filter.pvalue$estimate, 2), " p-val < 0.001"),
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size=10
  )+
  ggtitle("Before Pop. Structure Correction")+ 
  theme(
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size =30),
    axis.title   = element_text(size = 30),   # axis titles
    axis.text    = element_text(size = 20),   # axis tick labels
    legend.title = element_text(size = 30),   # legend title
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 20)    # legend labels
  )+
  xlab("USA dataset\n-log10(p-value)")+
  ylab("Netherlands dataset\n-log10(p-value)")

# Plot p-values after population structure adjustment
r_val_lrt.pvalue <-cor.test(-log10(NLD_CDC_pyseer_df$lrt.pvalue_NLD), -log10(NLD_CDC_pyseer_df$lrt.pvalue_CDC))
p_corr_after <-NLD_CDC_pyseer_df |>
  ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(x=-log10(lrt.pvalue_CDC), y=-log10(lrt.pvalue_NLD))) +
  theme_classic()+
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 6, y = 5,
    label = paste0("r = ", round(r_val_lrt.pvalue$estimate, 2), " p-val < 0.001"),
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size=10
  )+
  ggtitle("After Pop. Structure Correction")+ 
  theme(
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size =30),
    axis.title   = element_text(size = 30),   # axis titles
    axis.text    = element_text(size = 20),   # axis tick labels
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15),   # legend title
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 20)    # legend labels
  )+
  xlab("USA dataset\n-log10(p-value)")+
  ylab("Netherlands dataset\n-log10(p-value)")

# # Plot ORs
# r_val_OR <-cor.test((NLD_CDC_pyseer_df$OR_CDC), (NLD_CDC_pyseer_df$OR_NLD))
# 
# NLD_CDC_pyseer_df |>
#   ggplot()+
#   geom_point(aes(x=OR_CDC, y=OR_NLD))+
#   theme_classic()+
#   annotate(
#     "text",
#     x = 0.7, y = 1.4,
#     label = paste0("r = ", round(r_val_OR$estimate, 2), " p-val < 0.001"),
#     hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5
#   )

# Combine
p_corr_before_after <- p_corr_before + p_corr_after
ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/2. Analysis/MS1 - USA GWAS interpretation/GWAS_pval_corr_USA_vs_NDL.png", p_corr_before_after, width = 20, height = 10, dpi = 300)
ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/2. Analysis/MS1 - USA GWAS interpretation/GWAS_pval_corr_USA_vs_NDL.tiff", p_corr_before_after, width = 20, height =10, dpi = 300)
```
